Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great overview of your ingestion latency and retention constraints. As a next step I'd like to lock a 30-minute product intro that includes a quick ops checklist so your infra team can validate integration feasibility.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all PDT):
- Option A: Tue Jun 2, 10:00–10:30
- Option B: Wed Jun 3, 13:00–13:30
- Option C: Thu Jun 4, 08:30–09:00

Please pick two that work for you (or propose alternatives) and confirm which NovumHealth attendees will join (engineering lead + security/ops preferred). I'll bring Karthik (solutions) and include Mina from infra if we lock the slot.

Quick prep I'm attaching: mutual_action_plan.pdf (outline + milestone owners) and tech_precall_checklist.docx (network & auth checklist). If there's anything sensitive you want excluded from the demo recording, let me know.

Next steps once slot is confirmed:
- I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (demo + 10 min Q&A + next steps)
- Karthik will surface a lightweight integration plan and prerequisites

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
